About the Spruce Grove service area

Draft copy — pending the owner's review; wording and distances are approximate.

Spruce Grove sits west of Edmonton on the Yellowhead, beside Stony Plain, and like Leduc it pairs an established core with fast-growing new neighbourhoods. That means two kinds of jobs: repainting exteriors that have seen a few Alberta winters, and putting a personal finish on freshly built interiors that all arrived the same shade of grey.

Chris Lloyd Ltd handles interior and exterior painting plus small renovation work across Spruce Grove. Start at the main site's contact section to get a quote.

Where we're coming from: the shop is at 10412 66 Ave NW in west Edmonton; Spruce Grove is west of Edmonton on the Yellowhead (Highway 16), next to Stony Plain — about twenty-five minutes from downtown.

Painting & renovation services in Spruce Grove

The same interior, exterior and renovation work the main site describes, phrased for Spruce Grove homes.

Interior Painting

Spruce Grove interior painting: walls, ceilings, trim and woodwork, with tidy prep and clean lines. Furniture and floors are masked and protected; dust is minimised rather than swept under the drop sheet.

Exterior Painting

Spruce Grove exterior work: fascias, soffits, doors, garage siding and masonry accents, prepped and coated to hold up to an Alberta winter. Repairs and rot checks are flagged before the first brush stroke.

Renovation & Touch-Ups

Spruce Grove renovation support: drywall repair and painting, small refreshes, and finishing touch-ups around the rest of the job. Handover-ready rather than almost-finished.
